description: Abstract Java class 'BaseOpenmrsData' providing default implementations for data objects in OpenMRS, including properties like creator, dateCreated, voided status, and related getter/setter methods. It serves as a base class for entity data in the OpenMRS data model.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsData
classes.description: Abstract base class in OpenMRS providing common data properties such as creator, date created, voided status, and associated getter/setter methods, serving as a foundation for data entities.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the User object who created this data record.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the User object as the creator of this data record.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date of this data record.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of this data record.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who last changed this data, deprecated from version 2.2.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who last changed this data, deprecated from version 2.2.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date of the last change, deprecated from version 2.2.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date of the last change, deprecated from version 2.2.

methods.name: getVoided
methods.description: Returns whether this data has been voided (soft-deleted).

methods.name: setVoided
methods.description: Sets the voided status of this data.

methods.name: getDateVoided
methods.description: Returns the date when this data was voided.

methods.name: setDateVoided
methods.description: Sets the date when this data was voided.

methods.name: getVoidedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who voided this data.

methods.name: setVoidedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who voided this data.

methods.name: getVoidReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for voiding this data.

methods.name: setVoidReason
methods.description: Sets the reason for voiding this data.
